Plan + set up

Launch small tests

CHECK / DELIVERValid contacts + grade and city fit.
DAYS11–15

Refine + grow

Improve creative, search terms and forms. Gradually increase promising campaigns.

CHECK / DELIVERQualified enquiries + cost + visit requests.

Media cost per attended visit Advertising spend ÷ Attributed attended visits Targets and forecasts follow agreed budgets and evidence. If no visit is attributed, cost per visit cannot be calculated. Some admissions may follow after the pilot.
